name: rosetta-equilibrium-index
code:
use default

equilibrium_indices(values: int[]) -> Pipe[int] is
    let total = values |> reduce(0, (sum, value) => sum + value)
    let below mut = 0

    for index in 0..values.count do
        if below * 2 + values[index] == total then
            yield index
        fi

        below = below + values[index]
    od
si

let sequence = [-7, 1, 5, 2, -4, 3, 0]

let indices = equilibrium_indices(sequence)
    |> map(index => "{index}")
    |> join(" ")

write_line("equilibrium indices: {indices}")
